implementation.Ronin: Printed3/3. Actual pay2life adds2 of exactly one color with once-per-turn use on exact incarnation; no tap cost. Mana lot can fund Equipment spells or an equip slot, including an equip ability inherited by a non-Equipment source. Other Equipment activations, channel, non-Equipment spells and triggered ward costs remain ineligible. Tap plus sacrifice a controlled current Equipment attached to exact Ronin is an ordinary owned additional cost, followed by target -4/-4 EOT, sorcery only.
implementation.Shang_Chi: Printed2/2. A live rule permission permits tap-cost activations of current controlled creatures immediately, including itself, intrinsic mana, printed, inherited and attached granted activations. Actual keywords and attack permission never acquire haste. Tap adds2 of one color restricted to activated abilities with current/LKI creature-source facts, including hand/graveyard creature cards.
implementation.shared_payment: Mana restrictions are captured independently of producer lifetime in existing owned lots. Immutable activated-slot equip identity is retained separately from source card types. Existing typed battlefield AttachSource-only activated programs identify equip; entry attachments, animation, channel and other programs are distinct. Actual payment, source-departure LKI and speculative funding reconstruct the same purpose.
implementation.shared_cost: SacrificeAttachedEquipment qualifies the exact attachment before normalizing to ordinary sacrifice. Actual candidates, selected-cost payment, borrowed reservations and virtual source-incarnation checks agree.
implementation.readiness: CharacteristicWorld.activation_keywords is an activation-only query. Its synthetic haste flag never appears in actual characteristic keywords, observations or attack rules. Virtual provider departure and suppression recompute the permission without changing the parent.
